usedFor: Todoist holds tasks and TestMonitor tracks test issues, so “New Task Created in Project” can feed “Create issue”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create issue” in TestMonitor
bestTemplate.why: A task added to a project becomes an issue with title, description, priority and assignee.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so “Create issue” runs after a scheduled check.
